description: Finds products on 1688 for an AUDIENCE or a NEED, without a keyword (“over 40s”, “children under 10”, “sleep”): Rabbit writes 10 to 15 searches in the words of 1688 buyers and returns the products by family, with their `produit` reference and the price per piece including order fees. Call it as soon as they ask what to import for an audience or a need, instead of making up products.

budget_piece_eur.description: The highest price per piece they accept, in euros (optional).

pays.description: The country where they sell, as a two-letter code (FR, US…). Optional: their account’s country.

public.description: The audience or the need, in their words (“over 40s”, “sleep”).

name: explore_an_audience
title: Explore an audience
